name: Short Final route files
source: github.com/vradarserver/standing-data (Virtual Radar Server standing data, routes/schema-01 and airports/schema-01)
format: a file is { "airline": code, "routes": { callsign: "stop-stop-..." } }: the stops in the order flown, ICAO codes; a callsign is normalised (its number has no leading zeros). An airline with "split": true has one file per first digit of the number.
